environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. ALB forwards all HTTP traffic to the Flask app on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, ALB to EC2 on 8080. No additional request inspection or filtering rules configured on the ALB. TLS termination at ALB with default listener rules (forward all to target group). The application handles its own authentication via X-API-Key header.
